write_up: You’re an Information student with a data analytics internship at Great Lakes Credit Union and a treasurer role in the Michigan Data Science Club. This is a common early-career resume: it names useful tasks and tools, but leaves much of the work behind them unstated. A recruiter would likely finish it, then hesitate because it’s hard to distinguish your analytics work from other internship experience.
The survey cleaning line is a good model: it names the data and the tools you used. Your Education section makes sense above Experience while you’re still completing your degree.
